moes.name: areaUnderWatchFraction
moes.basis: Worst case 0.78. Basis: twelve drones, 40 min endurance, 20 min battery swap gives at most 40/60 airborne. Transit of up to 4 km each way at 18 m/s is about 7.4 min of the 40, leaving about 32.6 min of watching per 60 min cycle, so about 6.5 drones watch at a time. 6.5 x 3.0 km2 is about 19.6 km2 of 25 km2. Target 0.9 is not met by this arithmetic.
